2556-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2556-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1418-2226-2950.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-2950.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying its mana cost.
When Aven Surveyor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

643-2099-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2099-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2063-7841-8089.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

413-4559-5184-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4559-5184-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4399-4770-5070-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5070-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2590-5776-6968-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1232-5499-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-7730.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3967-5058-7422.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5356-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
5356-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
5356-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Barbed Servitor.
Barbed Servitor triggers, causing an opponent to lose 100 life.

1409-1449-4365.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2919-3330-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3330-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-5900-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2091-2556-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2556-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Mnemonic Wall with haste.
When the Mnemonic Wall tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1497-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

390-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph.
390-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
390-4608-5466.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Hulking Metamorph's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

222-2060-6701-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control another nontoken creature.
222-2060-6701-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and another nontoken creature.
When the creatures are sacrificed, Szarel triggers twice, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to twice Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-2060-6701-6798.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2281-3305-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

252-997-5394.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1429-5147-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5147-5402-5929.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

645-997-1267-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-997-1267-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

891-2523-5515-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

3512-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3512-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3512-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-4050-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-4050-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

712-4474-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Soliton.
712-4474-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Wake Thrasher triggers, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1029-4007-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Reckless Racer does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Reckless Racer.
1029-4007-4474.description:
Activate Reckless Racer by tapping it, adding {1}.
Reckless Racer triggers, causing you to rummage.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Reckless Racer.
Repeat.

2750-4003-4312.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U}{U}{U} your first turn, with {G}{U} available each extra turn
2750-4003-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Mu Yanling has at least ten loyalty counters on it.
2750-4003-4312.description:
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Mu Yanling to become an artifact.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Mu Yanling.
Activate Mu Yanling's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

92-2200-4658.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-2200-4658.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Activate Diamond Valley by tapping it and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's power.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1874-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
1874-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Ajani's Welcome and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
